verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key: its core product is a physical device that already runs locally, with no hosted service to self-host. Self-hosting is therefore a category error for this product type. The open-source Rust firmware and installable releases concern openness and updatability, not running a hosted service yourself, so they do not make the self-hosting axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
